subject: AWS Marketplace listing — buyer personas & trial scenarios
messages:
From: Emma Burke <emma.burke@retailco.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: AWS listing copy — buyer personas & trial scenarios

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for taking this on. We need help shaping the AWS Marketplace product page so it speaks to three buyer personas (Platform Admin, ML Lead, and Lines-of-Business/Product Owner) and includes short, concrete trial scenarios for each persona — things that will motivate procurement and reduce buyer friction.

Quick context: RetailCo integrates our search/embeddings engine with a small on-prem connector; we want listing language that covers a hosted vs. private deployment callout, and a short procurement-ready bullet list (SaaS pricing, trial length, entitlement notes).

I've attached a brief (retailco-integration-overview.pdf) and a sketch of the product packaging. Can you share a versioned copy of the Marketplace bullets and trial scenarios that we can include in the AWS listing and hand to field sellers?

Timeline: we want copy by end-of-week next Wednesday (2026-09-16) so procurement can start the private offer.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if helpful.

Cheers,
Emma
Emma Burke | Head of Partnerships, RetailCo

On Fri, Sep 11, 2026 at 08:48 AM Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marissa / Karthik 3 forwarding RetailCo ask. Key asks: persona-first bullets for the AWS product page and short trial scenarios that sales can paste into outreach / procurement docs.

Quick edits from copy:
- For AWS listing headline: avoid product-first lingo. Suggest: "Low-latency LLM inference for product search & recommendations" (keeps it category-agnostic).
- Persona bullets: make each 1-2 short bullets (lead + one evidence line). Example: "Platform Admin: Single-pane provisioning; pay-as-you-go or private VPC deployments — includes audit logs and KMS integration."
- Trial scenarios: convert to three one-paragraph "what you'll do" steps with expected outcomes (e.g., 30-min install, 2-hour test query run, sample metrics to validate).

Also: keep benefit claims verifiable (no hard claim like "reduces latency by 90%" unless supported). Add a one-line evidence pointer: "See performance notes (link) or attach benchmark PDF)."

I made inline edits in buyer-persona-snippets.docx and left comments on trial-scenarios.csv.

-M
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-12T09:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Kickoff: AWS listing copy — buyer personas & trial scenarios

Irene,

Looping procurement/entitlements guidance here: retail customers often want a 30-day trial SKU mapping for Marketplace (metered or flat). Recommend: 
- Default trial: 30-day metered trial (SKU: RC-TRIAL-30-METERED) with clear entitlements listed in a short bullet.
- Private Offer note: include single-row contact: procurement@redwood.com and a standard template (I attached the example in our shared drive).

On the deployment wording: call out that Private deployments require a different entitlements doc and separate audit evidence (SOC2 link). Avoid promising on-prem unless we confirm the connector support.

I've added procurement snippet lines to the AWS copy doc (aws-marketplace-copy-v1.docx).

Karthik
Head of Partnerships Ops | Redwood Inference
